covered_report_window.plain_language: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Friday, October 16, 2026 close and before the Monday, October 19, 2026 open.

market_context_summary: Hot September CPI/PPI and a roughly 5.1% 10-year Treasury yield keep rates, credit and valuation sensitivity elevated; the S&P 500 was down about 0.7% intraday Friday and the Nasdaq was under heavier pressure.
universe_exclusions_summary: No Friday after-close name met the official timing standard. Other Monday pre-open calendar entries were excluded before scoring for weak timing confirmation, insufficient evidence, foreign-event timing ambiguity, or limited liquidity.

methodology.consensus_direction_score: Arithmetic mean of Pass A, B and C, rounded.
methodology.consensus_reversal_risk: Arithmetic mean of Pass A, B and C, rounded.
methodology.disparity_metric: 0-100 composite: average of normalized pairwise direction-score gaps and pairwise reversal-risk gaps; lower means tighter agreement.
methodology.learned_lessons_review: Applied mandatory expectation-bar, decisive-metric, forward-look and separate reversal-risk checks. No new method change was warranted.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Beat priced in; Q4 steel/auto outlook
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: A/B/C all positive; strength ranged +27 to +48
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A guided step-up in Q3 EBITDA and sharply higher estimates favor upside, but the stock's rerating and a demanding options hurdle make a sell-the-news reversal unusually plausible.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Public consensus is roughly $0.19-$0.23 EPS and $5.72-$5.78B revenue; management guided Q3 adjusted EBITDA to about $575M.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: EBITDA clears guidance on realization, shipments and Stelco improvement, with constructive Q4 pricing commentary.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: The quarter meets the raised bar but weaker auto demand, margins, cash flow or Q4 tone exposes priced-in optimism.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Weekly options imply about 12.8%; short interest is about 13.8%, creating both squeeze potential and volatility-unwind risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q3 revenue estimates rose about 4% over three months; EPS expectations moved sharply higher from a low base.

ranked_companies.pass_agreement: A/B/C positive; one pass remained Neutral
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Deposit growth, NII momentum and completed Comerica conversion support modest upside, but credit migration and downward estimate revisions leave only a threshold-level edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: The cleanest current preview puts adjusted EPS near $1.09, while public providers disagree materially because acquisition items complicate the comparison.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: NII, deposit mix and merger synergies beat expectations while provision expense remains contained.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Nonperformers, funding costs or integration expenses offset revenue growth and make the apparent EPS beat low quality.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The nearest public monthly straddle implies about 7.1%, but it includes several post-event weeks and overstates a pure earnings move.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: One public revision set shows 2 upward versus 11 downward changes over 30 days; seven-day consensus was stable at $1.09.

research_allocation_view.statement: No name met all allocation rules; the full notional basket remains unallocated. This is a research prioritization model, not financial advice.
